note: Tunables of the combat micro layer (src/ai/combat, A13). Rank differences enter ONLY through the profile fields reaction time, aim error and error rates (src/data/bots/profiles/*.json); nothing here depends on the rank. Distances in units, times in seconds unless the name says ticks.

parts.note: Parts of the micro layer that are on (flag.ts). tick = per-tick combo executor in the reflex layer: measured worse than the decision-rate execution in A/B games (docs/agents/wave1-a13.md), so off; BOT_MICRO_ON=tick turns it on for measurements. spacing = ranged spacing from the enemy hint ranges: self-play Gold 8 x 14 min cost ~2 kills/game (13.6 -> 11.6) and the benchmark trade balance got worse at Diamond, so off; BOT_MICRO_ON=spacing turns it on.

aim.note: Skillshot aim from the target's OBSERVED velocity (previous tick -> now). leadNoiseDivisor: sigma of the lead factor = profile.aimErrorDeg / divisor (a clean lead is 1.0). jukeLateral / jukeSpeed: assumed uncertainty of the target's path as a share of its lateral / total speed. minConfidence: do not throw below this hit confidence (poke = free lane harassment, fight = trade or fight, where the throw also forces the target to react). rangeShare: share of the ability range at which the intercept point may lie.

dodge.note: Per-tick dodge of visible enemy casts (line skillshots from cast events, ground telegraphs from zone events). Reaction = the profile's reaction time (+ attention penalty); predictiveDodgePct reads the cast wind-up (reaction 0). There is no 'ignore x % of the threats' roll: the rank acts through reaction time, predictiveDodgePct and the attention model. margin: extra distance beyond the danger edge. hold: ticks the bot stops deciding after the dodge move so the next decision does not walk back into the missile. minThreat: ignore abilities with a lower hints threat. dashThreat: from this threat on (hard CC, ultimates) an escape dash / blink is used when walking out is too slow.

spacing.note: Spacing of a ranged bot to an enemy champion (src/ai/combat/spacing.ts). safeMargin: beyond the reach of a ready gap closer / a melee auto; punishInside: step this far inside the own range when every offensive spell of the enemy is known down; minRanged: floor.

focus.note: Teamfight focus score (src/ai/combat/focus.ts). threat = threatBase + threatPerPower x (burst + poke + CC abilities) +- role bonus; kill = 1.3 - hp share, x squishyBonus below squishyShare of the average effective HP; access falls off over accessFalloff beyond the reach and x shieldedFactor behind a frontliner (not for assassins); retaliate / pingBonus are added.
